reason: Not notice-only: the bulletin requires substantive relocation payments (amounts by tenant status, tenancy length and income, paid within 15 days) for not-at-fault evictions under the RSO, with an affirmative defense for nonpayment. Amounts, period, citation (LAMC 151.09 is cited in the document) and quote match the text; no end_date set.

rule.title: RSO no-fault eviction relocation assistance
rule.requirement: For no-fault evictions from rent-stabilized (RSO) units in Los Angeles, the landlord must file a Declaration of Intent to Evict with LAHD and pay relocation assistance within 15 days of the notice. For July 2026 to June 2027 the amounts range from $11,000 to $27,400 depending on tenancy length, income, and whether the tenant is qualified (62+, disabled, or with minor children).
rule.requirement_es: En desalojos sin culpa de unidades con renta estabilizada (RSO) en Los Ángeles, el propietario debe presentar una Declaración de Intención de Desalojo ante LAHD y pagar asistencia de reubicación dentro de 15 días del aviso. De julio de 2026 a junio de 2027 los montos van de $11,000 a $27,400 según la duración del arrendamiento, los ingresos y si el inquilino es calificado (62+ años, con discapacidad o con hijos menores).
rule.coverage_text: No-fault evictions (owner/relative/manager occupancy, demolition or removal from rental use, government order to vacate, conversions, etc.) from units covered by the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance. Reduced amounts for Mom and Pop properties for owner/family occupancy evictions.
rule.penalty: Failure to file the Landlord Declaration makes the eviction a violation of the RSO; tenant may raise non-payment as an affirmative defense.
rule.quote:
All tenant not- at-fault evictions require payment of relocation assistance and the filing of a 
Declaration of Intent to Evict form with the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD) before 
evicting tenants from units covered by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) or the Just Cause 
Ordinance (JCO).
